papers.title: Exploring the implementation of a long COVID rehabilitation intervention: a mixed-methods process evaluation.
papers.abstract: Long COVID is recognised as a global public health concern, creating demand for rehabilitation. Despite a growing evidence base on long COVID rehabilitation interventions, knowledge of the implementation of these interventions remains limited, constraining adaptation and transfer across health care settings. In a previous study, the programme theory of a Danish community-based long COVID rehabilitation intervention was refined. However, uncertainties regarding its implementation remain. This study therefore aimed to explore the delivery and implementation of The Long COVID Rehabilitation Intervention. This convergent mixed-methods process evaluation focused on what was delivered (reach, fidelity, and dose) and how it was delivered (implementation processes and adaptations). Quantitative data comprised baseline patient questionnaires and routine rehabilitation patient records. Qualitative data comprised a focus group interview with health professionals and an individual interview with the rehabilitation centre manager. Quantitative data were analysed descriptively, and qualitative data were analysed using content analysis. Findings were integrated narratively. In total, 336 patients were included of whom 325 patients were referred for rehabilitation and 321 initiated the programme. Most patients were female, had a long education and were employed or enrolled in education prior to their COVID-19 disease. Median rehabilitation length was 183 days (IQR 131-261), and the patients received a median of 13 sessions (IQR 8-22). Overall, key intervention activities were consistently delivered. Most rehabilitees received a combination of individual and group-based sessions, with the energy management group being the most common. Variation over time was observed in median rehabilitation length and number of sessions delivered, reflecting adaptations to the intervention over time. Adaptations and implementation were influenced by contextual conditions concerning flexible delivery within a clear structure, knowledge of long COVID, space for reflection and adaptation, and organisational recognition and legitimacy. This paper reports the implementation and delivery of The Long COVID Rehabilitation Intervention and highlights key contextual conditions that shaped these processes. These findings may inform adaptation and transfer of similar rehabilitation interventions to other health care settings. Future development and adaptation of long COVID rehabilitation should explicitly consider equity in access to ensure rehabilitation services reach diverse patient groups. ClinicalTrials.gov, NCT06544382. Registered retrospectively on 9 August 2024.
papers.summary: 本研究採用混合方法過程評估，探討丹麥社區長新冠康復干預措施的實施與交付情況。研究納入336名患者，多數為女性、高學歷且就業中。患者中位數接受13次、為期183天的康復療程，核心活動（特別是能量管理團體）能穩定交付，但療程長度與次數隨時間出現變化，顯示干預措施經歷了適應性調整。實施過程主要受結構清晰的靈活交付、專業知識、反思調整空間及組織認可等情境條件影響。
papers.significance: 此研究填補了長新冠康復干預措施實際落地過程的知識空白，揭示了影響干預措施成功交付的關鍵情境因素。這些發現為類似康復計畫在不同醫療環境中的適應與轉移提供了重要參考，同時特別呼籲未來在發展康復服務時必須正視公平性問題，以確保資源能惠及不同的患者群體。

papers.title: 'We know what the barriers are, but nothing changes' - Professional perspectives on promoting breast cancer screening initiatives for ethnic minority women.
papers.abstract: Despite long-standing efforts to increase breast cancer screening uptake, there are substantial inequalities in access and outcomes for ethnic minority women. Despite much research focussing on the views of minoritised groups on barriers to their attendance, systemic factors have received limited attention. Seventeen professionals responsible for implementing initiatives to promote screening equity for minoritised groups took part in semi-structured online interviews. Data were analysed using reflexive thematic analysis. Three themes were developed: (1) Structural inequities: moving from system centred design to community centred care: professionals described entrenched systemic misalignments that disadvantage women from minoritised communities, (2) Hostile environment effects on healthcare engagement: wider societal racism and exclusionary policies were seen to undermine trust and access, (3) Innovation within constraints: participants described grassroots, community centred strategies, though these often relied on individual initiative rather than system level support. Professionals working to promote breast screening uptake for ethnic minority women described numerous systemic challenges that hinder equity. Structural reform to breast screening programmes which goes beyond translation and cultural competency is needed to produce greater equity in uptake for minoritised communities. Findings highlight the importance of designing healthcare systems so that they are more appropriate for ethnic minority women.
papers.summary: 本研究探討了專業人員對促進少數族裔女性乳腺癌篩檢的觀點。透過對17名負責推動篩檢公平的專業人士進行訪談，研究發現三大主題：系統設計以機構為中心而非社區導致結構性不平等；社會的種族主義與排外政策削弱了少數族裔對醫療的信任；以及基層的社區創新策略常受限於缺乏系統層級的支持。研究指出，現行篩檢計畫需進行超越單純語言翻譯與文化能力的結構性改革，才能真正提升少數族裔女性的篩檢公平性。
papers.significance: 此研究將焦點從少數族裔個人的就醫障礙轉向醫療系統的結構性缺陷，揭示了「敵意環境」與系統設計失靈是導致篩檢不平等的根源。這對公共衛生政策制定具有重要啟示，呼籲醫療體系必須進行根本的結構變革，而非僅依賴基層人員的個別努力或表面的文化適應，為實現真正的醫療公平提供了明確的實踐方向。

papers.title: Perceived barriers and opportunities to the continuous distribution of ivermectin in the Cameroon primary health care system: an exploratory study of major stakeholders.
papers.abstract: Onchocerciasis, a debilitating parasitic disease transmitted by blackflies, remains a significant public health concern in Cameroon. While mass drug administration (MDA) campaigns with ivermectin offer success in controlling transmission, logistical and financial challenges threaten long-term sustainability. Integrating ivermectin distribution into the existing primary healthcare system (PHC) could offer a promising alternative. We aimed to explore challenges and opportunities associated with this integration. This study employed a mixed-methods approach conducted across five regions in Cameroon. Qualitative methods (in-depth interviews and focus group discussions) were used to explore stakeholder perceptions at all levels of the distribution ladder. Quantitative data on program costs and drug coverage were extracted from district campaign reports. Stakeholder perspectives on Ivermectin Integration (n = 130) revealed strong support for partial integration within the primary healthcare system. Stakeholders from various levels (health system, healthcare workers, and community members) perceived this approach as simple and readily implementable. Most stakeholders viewed this approach as viable to ensure a continued ivermectin administration despite funding shortfalls. However, concerns were raised regarding management of adverse events and a potential misuse of ivermectin. Additionally, our analysis revealed an estimated cost of 53 CFA francs (0.1 USD) per person treated. By exploring the partial integration of ivermectin distribution within Cameroon's primary healthcare system, this research paves the way for sustainable onchocerciasis control. Clinical trials and community education initiatives are crucial next steps to validate and optimize this promising strategy.
papers.summary: 盤尾絲蟲病在喀麥隆仍是嚴重的公共衛生問題，傳統大規模藥物施用面臨財務與物流挑戰。本研究透過混合方法探討將伊維菌素發放整合至初級保健系統的可行性，結果顯示多數利益相關者強烈支持部分整合，認為此法簡單且能克服資金短缺問題，每人治療成本僅約0.1美元，但同時對不良反應管理與藥物誤用風險表達擔憂。
papers.significance: 本研究為喀麥隆及其他面臨資金挑戰的地區，提供了一種可持續控制盤尾絲蟲病的創新策略。透過驗證將藥物發放部分整合至現有基層醫療體系的低成本與高可行性，有助於減輕對外部資金的依賴，並為後續推動臨床試驗與社區教育奠定了重要的實證基礎。

papers.title: "Either you feel bad and stay, or you're smart and leave" - perspectives from emergency department staff in Stockholm, Sweden.
papers.abstract: Job attrition and burnout among healthcare staff is a substantial challenge for healthcare systems globally. Staff working in emergency departments (ED) face work environment challenges including moral distress. This study explores causes, consequences, and contextual dimensions of moral distress among ED staff. A total of 36 healthcare professionals from EDs at two hospitals in Stockholm, Sweden, participated in the study. Seven interprofessional focus group sessions were conducted. These were audio-recorded, transcribed verbatim, and analyzed using reflexive thematic analysis. Participants described providing care under conditions of limited resources and high demands. Drivers of moral distress included inadequate nursing care, futile care, ethical dilemmas, organizational barriers, experiencing team-related challenges and lack of control. Ethical challenges were particularly evident in the care of vulnerable groups, especially geriatric and palliative patients. Participants identified systemic factors such as organizational errors, long waiting times, insufficient staffing, and lack of hospital beds as contributors to moral distress. Reported consequences included worsened well-being, a negatively influenced self-image, delayed reactions, and emotional numbing. Some participants expressed intentions to leave their roles, alongside frustration and distrust toward the healthcare system. Moral distress emerged as a persistent and normalized feature of ED work, percieved to be primarily driven by resource limitation. These issues need addressing on a policy level. In parallel, strategies to manage moral distress in the ED setting are needed. This has implications for individual healthcare workers' well-being and organizational stability. Not applicable.
papers.summary: 本研究探討瑞典斯德哥爾摩急診室（ED）員工面臨的道德困境及其成因與影響。研究透過焦點小組訪談發現，在資源有限與高需求的工作環境下，護理不足、無效醫療、組織障礙及缺乏控制權是引發道德困境的主要驅動因素，尤其在照護老年與安寧緩和患者時最為明顯。這種困境已成為急診工作的常態，並導致員工身心健康惡化、情感麻木，甚至產生離職意願與對醫療體系的不信任。
papers.significance: 此研究突顯了醫療體系資源配置不足對前線人員所造成的深遠道德傷害，強調道德困境不僅是個人心理問題，更是系統性的組織危機。研究結果為醫療政策制定者提供了重要啟示，呼籲必須從政策層面改善系統性資源短缺（如人力與床位），並在組織內部發展道德困境管理策略，以維護醫療人員福祉、降低離職率，進而保障整體醫療體系的穩定與運作品質。

papers.title: Availability, prices and affordability of nationally negotiated antidiabetic medicines in China: a national survey.
papers.abstract: This study aimed to investigate the availability, prices, and affordability of nationally negotiated antidiabetic medicines in China. This study collected monthly medicine usage data from 2018 to 2023 from the China Medical Economic Information Network (CMEI). The study focused on 12 nationally negotiated antidiabetic medicines included in the 2020 edition of the National Reimbursement Drug List for Basic Medical Insurance, Work-Related Injury Insurance, and Maternity Insurance. This study covered 804 public general hospitals in 31 provincial administrative regions in China, among which 537 (66.79%) were tertiary, and 267 (33.21%) were secondary. The adjusted World Health Organization and Health Action International methodology was used to conduct a longitudinal descriptive analysis of the availability and affordability of 12 nationally negotiated antidiabetic drugs in the investigated hospitals. Besides, prices are expressed as the defined daily dose cost (DDDc). From 2018 to 2023, the number of antidiabetic medicines with availability exceeding 50% increased from 1 to 5. The total availability of the 12 medicines was higher in tertiary hospitals than in secondary hospitals. The DDDc of the 12 medicines decreased substantially from baseline, with reduction rates ranging from 22.78% to 90.39%. Affordability improved progressively over the study period, with declines ranging from 43.43% to 97.52%. In 2023, 7 out of the 12 antidiabetic medicines were affordable for the population. However, rural residents had lower affordability of the medicines than urban residents. The overall availability, affordability and DDDc of 12 nationally negotiated antidiabetic medicines improved from 2018 to 2023. However, the overall availability of most antidiabetic medicines in China remained at a low level (less than 50%). Therefore, further efforts should be made to sufficiently and equally benefit patients with diabetes.
papers.summary: 本研究調查了2018至2023年中國804家公立醫院中12種國家談判降糖藥的可用性、價格與可負擔性。結果顯示，這些藥物的限定日劑量成本（DDDc）大幅下降22.78%至90.39%，可負擔性顯著提升，2023年已有7種藥物達到可負擔標準。然而，多數藥物的整體可用性仍低於50%，且三級醫院的可用性高於二級醫院，農村居民的可負擔性亦遜於城市居民。
papers.significance: 該研究客觀評估了中國國家醫保談判政策在慢性病領域的實施成效，揭示了藥價顯著降低與基層醫院可及性依然不足之間的矛盾。此發現為未來優化醫保目錄落實機制、縮小城鄉醫療資源差距，以及確保糖尿病患平等受益提供了關鍵的實證依據。

papers.title: Secure Attachment Schemas Guide Expectations of Support: Electrophysiological Evidence.
papers.abstract: Attachment schemas, shaped by relational experiences in infancy and early childhood, encode core beliefs about the self, close others, and relationship dynamics, guiding expectations of support in times of distress. While extensive research has documented attachment-related biases in cognition, evidence for their neural correlates remains limited. In this ERP study, we examined neural activity linked to attachment-schema-based expectations of support. Thirty-nine Swedish-speaking, right-handed women read short narratives depicting either stressful (attachment condition) or neutral (non-attachment condition) situations, ending with either a supportive or a non-supportive outcome. Participants rated ease of visualization for each narrative. A N400 effect was found for attachment contexts, revealing stronger negative responses for non-supportive versus supportive endings, indicating violated expectations. Additionally, late positive potential (LPP) effects emerged: non-supportive endings elicited greater positivity in attachment narratives, whereas supportive endings did so in non-attachment narratives, reflecting heightened emotional reactivity. Critically, the N400 effect was significant in securely, but not insecurely, attached participants. Regardless of narrative context, only securely attached individuals showed enhanced visualization for supportive (vs. non-supportive) endings. Together, our findings provide direct neural evidence to the central assumption of attachment theory that attachment schemas operate as implicit knowledge structures guiding expectations of support.
papers.summary: 本研究透過腦電圖（ERP）技術探討依戀圖式如何引導個體在壓力情境下對支持的預期。研究讓39名女性閱讀以支持或非支持結尾的壓力與中性敘事，結果發現在依戀情境中，非支持結局會引發N400效應（代表預期違背）與LPP效應（代表情緒反應增強）。關鍵發現是，N400效應僅在安全型依戀受試者中顯著，且僅有安全型依戀者對支持結局的想像力評分較高，顯示不安全型依戀者缺乏此種基於圖式的支持預期。
papers.significance: 此研究首次透過神經生理學證據（N400與LPP腦電波成分），直接驗證了依戀理論的核心假設：依戀圖式確實作為一種隱性知識結構，引導個體對人際支持的預期。這不僅釐清了安全型與不安全型依戀在認知與神經層面的差異，也為理解早期關係經驗如何塑造終身的大腦訊息處理與情緒反應提供了重要的科學基礎。

papers.title: It's Subjective! Effects of Perceptions of Success and Objective Outcomes on Feedback-Related Brain Activity in a Motor Learning Paradigm.
papers.abstract: Feedback processing affects motor learning and performance. Importantly, the same objective outcome can lead to feedback that is subjectively perceived as indicating success or failure depending on task instructions. To understand how practice conditions affect the rewarding value of feedback, we recorded participants' electroencephalography while practicing a shuffleboard task under different criteria of success. We used mixed-effects models to investigate, on a trial-by-trial basis, how subjective success and objective error interact with each other to affect the feedback-related potential reward positivity (RewP), an index of reward prediction error. Results indicated that trials that met participants' arbitrarily established criterion of success elicited larger RewP amplitudes than trials subjectively perceived as unsuccessful. Moreover, although smaller objective errors also resulted in larger RewP amplitudes compared to larger objective errors, we demonstrated that subjective success explained more RewP variance than objective error. We did not find sufficient evidence that criteria of success moderate the relationship between objective error and RewP, suggesting that error magnitude is interpreted in parallel and in addition to success, rather than one overriding the other. Overall, our results indicate that giving subjective meaning to learners' performance outcomes can be an effective and simple way for instructors to manipulate the brain's reward systems during practice, especially because the subjective interpretation of the outcome can have more influence on RewP than the objective level of accuracy. Finally, we also add evidence to the literature that RewP is also responsive to graded objective feedback and outcome expectancies in a learnable motor task.
papers.summary: 本研究探討在運動學習範式中，主觀成功感知與客觀誤差如何交互影響反饋相關腦電位（獎勵正波，RewP）。受試者在不同成功標準下進行沙狐球任務並記錄腦電圖。結果顯示，符合主觀成功標準的試驗比主觀失敗的試驗引發更大的RewP振幅。儘管客觀誤差較小也會產生較大的RewP，但主觀成功對RewP變異的解釋力優於客觀誤差。研究還發現，兩者為並行處理，並無互相覆蓋的關係。
papers.significance: 此研究證實了在學習過程中，主觀解釋對大腦獎勵系統的影響力甚至超越客觀準確度。這對教學與訓練具有重要啟示：指導者可透過簡單賦予表現結果主觀意義的方式，有效操控學習者大腦的獎勵機制，進而優化學習動機。此外，該研究也為RewP在可學習運動任務中對分級客觀反饋與結果預期具有敏感性提供了新證據。
